# FluidSynth Integration

## Purpose

**(Hypothesis)** Acts as a software MIDI synthesizer, turning MIDI notes into audible sound. This is likely how the knobs make sound.

## Communication
*   **(Hypothesis)** Listens for ALSA MIDI events generated by the `master-controller`.
*   **(Confirmed)** Outputs audio to the default ALSA device (our `dmix` mixer).
